annotations.title: Departed vntil a time.
annotations.text: <mn>◦</mn> No maruel if the diuel be often or alwaies busie with Chistian men, seeing after he was plainely ouercome by Christ, yet did he not giue him ouer altogether, but for a time.

annotations.title: Done in Capharnaum.
annotations.text: ◦ God maketh choise of persons and places where he worketh miracles or doeth benefits, though he might doe the same els where if it liked his wisedom. So doth he in doing miracles by Saints, not in al places, nor towards al persons, but as it pleaseth him. Aug. ep. 137.

notes.text: Miracles at one place and not at an other.

annotations.title: Passing through the middes of them.
annotations.text: <mn>◦</mn> Either by making him self inuisible, or also more wonderfully, penetrating the multitude and passing through them, as he did through the doore, his body either being without space of place, or with other bodies in one place. By al which and the like his doings mentioned in the Gospel, it is euident that he can alter and order his body as he list, aboue the natural conditions of a body.

notes.text: Christs body conteined in place aboue nature.

annotations.title: Simons wiues mother.
annotations.text: ◦ It is euident that Peter had a wife, but after his calling to be an Apostle, he leaft her, as S. Hierom writeth in many places ep. 34. c. 2. ad Iulianum. Li. 1. adu. Iouin. See the Annot. Matth. 19, 29.
